name: neilcatton-website
description: neilcatton.com — static site. Templates and data in src/, generated output in dist/. Netlify runs `npm run build`.
_comment_type: Deliberately NOT "type": "module". build.mjs and everything in tools/ use the .mjs extension, so they are ESM regardless. Three of the Netlify Functions (substack-feed.js, search-feed.js, practice-library-feed.js) are CommonJS — they use require() and exports.handler — and declaring the package as ESM makes Node parse those .js files as modules, which breaks all three at load time.

scripts.check: node build.mjs && node tools/check-a11y.mjs && node tools/check-links.mjs

_comment_dev: Test-only. build.mjs itself imports nothing but node: builtins, and the webfonts are committed under src/assets/fonts, so a deploy needs none of these. PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD is set in netlify.toml so installing playwright here does not pull a browser into every deploy.
